channel.title: Wildcard Watch: GitLab
channel.description: Exploited vulnerabilities and attacks involving GitLab, each with its fix status and first step.

item.title: Patch now: Critical vulnerability in GitLab CE/EE
item.description:
GitLab CE/EE: CCB warning · fix available · CCB: patch immediately

First step: Install the security update for GitLab CE/EE. The CCB advisory lists the affected and fixed versions.

The Centre for Cybersecurity Belgium (CCB) warns about this and advises to patch immediately. The CCB advisory lists the affected versions and the fix.

Critical · Fix available · CVE-2026-103515, CVE-2026-105711, CVE-2026-105777, CVE-2026-110264, CVE-2026-112212

item.title: Patch: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition: Integer Overflow or Wraparound
item.description:
GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition: Memory corruption (possible RCE) · pre-auth · internet-facing · exploited from day 0 · fix: 19.2.8, 19.3.5, 19.4.2

First step: Update GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition to the fixed version for your release line (for example 19.2.8, 19.3.5 or 19.4.2).

GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition contain a integer overflow or wraparound vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated user to execute arbitrary code on the GitLab server via a specially crafted regular expression in a CI/CD configuration, due to insufficient regular expression validation.

Critical · Fix available · CVE-2026-97229, CVE-2026-100104, CVE-2026-100755, CVE-2026-101168, CVE-2026-103549

item.title: Patch: GitLab AI Gateway Critical Patch Release: 19.2.4, 19.3.2, and 19.4.1
item.description:
GitLab AI Gateway: exploited · fix: 19.2.4, 19.3.2, 19.4.1

First step: Update GitLab AI Gateway to the fixed version for your release line (for example 19.2.4, 19.3.2 or 19.4.1).

GitLab has remediated a vulnerability in the GitLab AI Gateway component affecting all versions of the AI Gateway from 18.1.6 before 19.2.4, 19.3 before 19.3.2, and 19.4 before 19.4.1 that, under certain conditions, could have allowed an authenticated user with Duo Agent Platform access to escape the prompt template sandbox via a specially crafted flow configuration, resulting in arbitrary command execution on the…

Critical · Fix available · CVE-2026-90970

item.title: Keep patched: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition: Path Traversal
item.description:
GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition: Path traversal (file read/write) · pre-auth · internet-facing · exploited from day 0 · fix: 18.11.12, 19.0.9, 19.1.8

First step: Update GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition to the fixed version for your release line (for example 18.11.12, 19.0.9 or 19.1.8).

GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated user to read arbitrary files due to an improper path confinement and missing authentication enforcement in the repository commits API.

Critical · Fix available · CVE-2026-85706
